text:
ria: Quick Q — where's the best place to slice p50/p95/p99 + TTFT for customer traffic? need dashboard links for an async ticket.
alex: For route-level latency start with Grafana > "inference_latency_by_route" dashboard. there's a p95/p99 panel per route and a TTFT heatmap. https://grafana.redwood.local/d/infer-latency
alex: tokens/sec is under the "tokenflow" board (panel id=42). look at `sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (route)` for request-level token rate.
sam: Can you paste the PromQL you use for TTFT? trying to add to our runbook.
alex: TTFT as the latency from request.accept -> first_token_emit. we report `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`.
ria: perfect, thanks. any jaeger traces pinned for slow p99s?
lina: yes — use the trace panel that links to jaeger with `attributes.route=...` filter. example link: https://jaeger.redwood.local/search?service=inference&tags=%7B%22route%22:%22/complete%22%7D
lina: if you're triaging, filter spans by `span.kind:inference` and look for long `kv-cache` or `model-init` spans.
sam: For alert tuning: current alert is `HighInferenceP95` firing at p95>250ms for 5m. thinking to split: p95>200ms or p99>500ms and also alert on tokens/sec drop by >40%.
alex: +1 split alerts. also add mute rule for canaries and prewarm windows. we used `route=canary` exclusion in the alert.
observability-bot: [alert] HighInferenceP95 is not firing in the last 24h — no action.
devops-bot: deploy finished on main @ 3581234580 — infra autoscaler bumped nodes by +2 during the rollout :shipit:
ria: ok i will update the ticket with those links and the PromQL snippets. tagging @lina for trace examples. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
